milestone: M3 — Symbolic QA views and legal partials
claim: No decode-path integration, training run, eval, benchmark, checkpoint, or ship claim. This records a Torch-free classification contract plus the OpenUI adapter that reuses the existing live fragment parser (validate_output) and CompletionForest, and the tests that pin the DSH1-07 acceptance criteria.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every admitted PREFIX replays to at least one verified terminal
acceptance_criteria.note: Certifies a real CompletionForest continuation exists (grammar/schema-admissible), not yet the stronger EnumerativeSupportOracle exhaustive verified-terminal certificate; see Reopen conditions in the paired markdown.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every FRAGMENT parses under its declared start rule
UNKNOWN/partial coverage never authorizes destructive pruning
acceptance_criteria.evidence: classify_partial_state performs no pruning/ranking/removal; partial coverage yields PREFIX, never a stronger guarantee

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No cut splits a lexical token or marker
acceptance_criteria.note: Opaque-region splice boundaries beyond framed literals are not yet checked; see Reopen conditions.

test_runs.result: 2 failed, rest passed (partial run, sandbox CPU-bound single-threaded torch made a full run too slow to complete in-session)
test_runs.note: test_lexer_literal_bytes_are_not_grammar_admitted and test_structural_preference_does_not_override_confident_binder fail with the identical KeyError/assert-mismatch on a clean git-stash checkout of this same worktree with none of this change's diffs applied -- a pre-existing local-environment gap (unrelated to compiler_draft.py/solver additions), not a regression introduced here. Confirmed by reproducing both failures independently before and after `git stash`/`git stash pop` around this change.

test_runs.result: 15/37 observed so far all passed, zero new failures; the sandbox's single-threaded CPU torch execution made completing the remaining tests too slow for the session run cap, so this partial result -- combined with the purely additive nature of the compiler_draft.py diff (two new top-level public functions and two __all__ entries; no existing function body touched) and the full solver/topology/capsule suite passing -- is the evidence recorded here rather than a completed full-file run
